pr_title: soc: stm32: Fix DBGMCU register write for SWO configuration
pr_body:
DBGMCU register, which is used for SWO pin configuration,
may not have TRACE_MODE bits in some STM32 MCUs.
Remove unnecessary clear for these MCUs.

Fixes #44584

Signed-off-by: Alexander Vasiliev <alex.m.vasil@gmail.com>

issue_context.title: SWO log output does not compile for STM32WB55
issue_context.body:
Building Zephyr with SWO log output for STM32WB55 target enabled fails due to the missing definition.

For example, hello_world sample fails with:
`west build -b nucleo_wb55rg samples/hello_world -DCONFIG_LOG=y -DCONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=y -DCONFIG_LOG_BACKEND_SWO=y`

```
/home/alex/zephyr-upstream/zephyr/soc/arm/st_stm32/common/soc_config.c: In function 'st_stm32_common_config':
/home/alex/zephyr-upstream/zephyr/soc/arm/st_stm32/common/soc_config.c:30:17: error: 'DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_MODE_Msk' undeclared (first use in this function); did you mean 'DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_IOEN_Msk'?
   30 |  DBGMCU->CR &= ~DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_MODE_Msk;
```

This happens because for some STM32 MCUs DBGMCU register does not have TRACE_MODE bits, which are responsible for Asynchronous/Synchronous trace mode selection.  For them it is enough to only set DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_IOEN bit.

The issue can be fixed with the following amendment to `soc/arm/st_stm32/common/soc_config.c`:
```
#ifdef CONFIG_LOG_BACKEND_SWO
#if defined(DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_MODE)
	/* TRACE pin assignment for asynchronous mode */
	DBGMCU->CR &= ~DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_MODE_Msk;
#endif
	/* Enable the SWO pin */
	DBGMCU->CR |= DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_IOEN;
#endif
```
Tested on nucleo_wb55rg board.

review_comments:
Open question:
I don't know much on this part, but this functions is also defined on U5 and L5, as well as `LL_DBGMCU_SetTracePinAssignment`.
So for these 2 series, is `LL_DBGMCU_SetTracePinAssignment()` a better choice than `LL_DBGMCU_EnableTraceClock(LL_DBGMCU_TRACE_ASYNCH)`?
As far as I can tell, for L5 and U5 we have to, at least, call both LL_DBGMCU_EnableTraceClock() and LL_DBGMCU_SetTracePinAssignment(). But I don't have the HW to try this, and suppose it is out of the scope of this PR.
L5 and U5 SWO is not supported by now (HAS_SWO=n).

It is actually strange that for WB series LL_DBGMCU_EnableTraceClock() is implemented like
```
__STATIC_INLINE void LL_DBGMCU_EnableTraceClock(void)
{
  SET_BIT(DBGMCU->CR, DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_IOEN);
}
```
when for L5 and U5 it is
```
__STATIC_INLINE void LL_DBGMCU_EnableTraceClock(void)
{
  SET_BIT(DBGMCU->CR, DBGMCU_CR_TRACE_CLKEN);
}
```
These are different bits, and different series have various combinations of them in DBGMCU, along with TRACE_MODE.
Ok, so to conclude, provided code is correct as long as SWO is kept as not supported on L5/U5.
